notes.title: PC Fútbol Stars – Service Closure
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/8babc68a0af72bac8f4f0b522100108147bcf8fe.png[/img]

Greetings, football fans!

We regret to announce that matches on PC Fútbol Stars are at an end.

The game’s servers will close down on May the 6th.

Stay tuned to IDC Games social media feed for more news.

Take care, and thank you for your patronage!

notes.title: The first massive update of PC Fútbol Stars is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/a116101e62a45be157ff5ea792551f4c510d1109.jpg[/img]

Football fans, the first massive update comes to PC Fútbol Stars. It includes, among other things, the possibility of playing between the different platforms. From now on you can play with your friends, whether from IDC/Games, Steam or Google Play. This new feature brings to the game a great rise of players against whom to play and win to reach the top.

Mini Games have been added. Thanks to them you will be able to obtain great rewards every day by overcoming fun positioning challenges in which, as usual, the main objective is to score a goal! As shown in the image below the goal has 3 different ranges in which the reward varies based on the difficulty to score. Do not forget, you will always have rivals in front of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/d6975832717cb163bcaade5d58ee2e79d9f05bd9.jpg[/img]

More than 200 new teams and 6 leagues in the game. PC Fútbol Stars receives a massive injection of new teams among which you will find teams from the Mexican, Brazilian, Argentinian or American league. Choose from the hundreds of teams you have at your disposal and find the one that will be the chosen one to reach the victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/4ad2f7359cacfbc781996ebd4c36c3ee738aebe8.jpg[/img]

From now on you will be able to complete missions and win amazing rewards that are useful to sign a new coach, select a new formation from the existing ones or acquire your Dream Team. The missions will vary with the days and each one will have a special challenge thanks to which, if you reach the victory, you will get a better reward. Go for the Ultimate Prize!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/1b02264fbdaa14eae02fd97e7fe6413967d6d173.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PC Fútbol Stars - Basic Guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/beafe875643178abc99474a97c04e76396bddb8c.png[/img]

1. This will be the first thing you see when entering the game. It is the loading screen. Once the process is finished, you may be asked to login.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/84de548e8d7dd492f7a6edc07f8b9f6e9fe8cb1b.jpg[/img]

2. This is the main menu of the game. Here you can select the game mode and access all the functionalities of PC Fútbol Stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/8371ff5846dc8101548b23a42afe1a84af1581e0.jpg[/img]

3. When you select mode 1 on 1 you can find the different leagues available. To access any of them you will have to pay the registration fee. If you manage to reach the victory you will get double what you had to pay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/211e1ad8338e1ec90fdfd76da7f83143d135ea45.jpg[/img]

4. In this section you will find the special events of PC Fútbol Stars. They are not always available, so we recommend you to be aware of the news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/8e52ecee2307fb86af2ea2f3c2dc34481b90b4ad.jpg[/img]

5. Once you start playing this is the most important part: the field. This is where you will have to demonstrate your skills by scoring all the goals you can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/53dc509c3c6f986ad6e2d65645fc1f2b07c7265f.jpg[/img]

6.1. This is the shop. Here you can unlock all the elements that will help you shape your legend in PC Fútbol Stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/7a70de126b78e5fd9a051bd06f764cf78052670e.jpg[/img]

6.2. In the store you can also acquire medals that will help you unlock game items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/44e71e46f5e4a78aee4bec5672562c250a69daa2.jpg[/img]

7. In this section you will find a selection of the best formations designed by our experts. Do not hesitate to try several until you find the one you like best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/dca15f30c0b9ae8cb222d7f2114029a198b136aa.jpg[/img]

8. Coaches are an important element. A good coach can give you certain advantages on the pitch. Check their passive skills and decide which one suits your style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/d3ed4fe42b007dec6c6751d8fd2cc21036ddce88.jpg[/img]

9. In the team’s section you can select your favorite team to represent it on the field and reach the victory in its name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/6e8489c129a325c9c5f52436330d4348d69ed5e5.jpg[/img]

10. Give your matches a social touch with the different emoji packs and chat phrases. There is nothing better than throwing a kiss at your opponent when you score a goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/421d7a0ccaef806427c174dc1e8acc9cb18d1e75.jpg[/img]

11. In the news section you can stay tuned about everything that happens in PC Fútbol Stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/f2cab82d34f222e59046594e4d7698a2319fe9e3.jpg[/img]

12. Click on the gear you will see in the lower left corner of the screen to access the options menu. Here you can adjust the sound options, language and consult the contact details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/6f6f6971d8601a2aba541be37f60b5766278de86.jpg[/img]

13. This is the profile. If you click on the player image located in the lower right corner you will access your profile. Here you can check all your statistics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/cbdc5c2d013ed959af9ae1b04bfc02534fc03d8c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Open Beta of PC Fútbol Stars starts today in PC and Android
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36013348/ca88c9f98cc5d0e8b603ccb90a1c5cda3fe64d3a.png[/img]

The newest member of the PC Fútbol games saga that allows cross-platform play between PC and Android users have been announced today by IDC/Games. 

The long history of the PC Fútbol games saga (known in the past as PC Calcio in Italy among others)   goes on growing with a new arcade football game joining the family. 

Developed by Silicon Games, an UAE based game studio, and Published by IDC/Games, a Spain based Game Publisher for PC and Mobile games, PC Fútbol Stars is a bottle caps football game that inherits all features from the more than 20 years old Football games saga.

The game is available from today as an Open Beta in Android and Windows PC at the IDC/Games platforms English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish and Turkish. The will be available on Steam in late October as well.

Players who wish to test the game now for free in PC can check it at IDC/Games platform and for Android devices at the Google Play Store.

Full game description and features as described in the mobile Stores:

Choose your team or national colors and play massive tournaments with players coming from PC and mobile versions! Start playing now in our bottle caps soccer or football league for free!

Your objective is to grow as a player and win every match in the different tournaments and events, or play 1 to 1 games or play offline against bots. You can even try to win every match in Russian event for the world event tournament!

This free football and soccer game is very intuitive to play; just enter into the field like a soccer tabletop with bottle caps teams and move them to play in the international World Cup.

Other PC Fútbol Stars features:

• Free game to play with friends in tournaments, all skill based!
• Play with your team of bottle caps several events and tournaments, get new coach, get amazing gear and equipment and become world champion!
• Multiplatform game, play versus mobile or PC users
• Best game for all people who like games for kids or free sports games playing casually
